data.title: Plant Diva gave Lulu and Georgia 4 stars. Check out the full review...
data.description: Excellent, unique website fir the home!!!
data.content:
I love the website. I have gotten gorgeous rugs that I couldn’t get anywhere else. I would love to speak to a live person or even get a call back to my questions or concerns. Customer service does answer you but I think a 5 star company should be able to be contacted via telephone. Just gives a better feeling to customers to have someone care enough to answer the phones. That being said, if Covid and the lack of employees is a problem I totally understand that! Not sure how it was pre-Covid since I just discovered website.

My other issue that somewhat bothers me is the outrageous shipping charges. There is a 10 percent shipping charge plus a huge shipping and delivery charge. So when there is a sitewide sale it barely covers the shipping charges, if at all. When I reached out to customer service they said they were working on making those fees more affordable. Almost makes it cost prohibitive when you live in Florida. 

Finally, getting updates on custom orders would be helpful. When you order items that have a 4 month plus timeframe it’s comforting to get updates or progress emails when the items are super expensive. 

I rarely write reviews. This company has so much to offer and just want to see them succeed and prosper. In this day in age I feel customer service and a quality product will go far. I love to support small private businesses and only want to provide constructive comments. 

I can’t wait to enjoy my new custom end of bed bench in February!

Thanks!
